verdict.rationale: AgentMail supports connecting standard IMAP/SMTP clients (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail), which gives users open-protocol access to their mailbox data rather than lock-in to a proprietary format, and the OpenAPI spec/CLI allow programmatic retrieval of messages. However there is no explicit documented 'export all data' or account-portability/data-takeout feature, and no evidence of exporting threads/attachments in bulk open formats. Missing for 10: explicit bulk export/backup tooling, documented data-portability guarantees, and confirmation of full account deletion with data takeout.
